# External comparison and sensitivity requests

The comparator runs outside the compiler and consumes three bound inputs: this immutable expected authority, original fixture bytes, and complete actual observations through the independently reviewed adapter mapping. It must first verify the complete freeze manifest and source identity, then the observer boundary/bounds/completion and row graph, then expected semantic facts. Record all first failures verbatim; do not refresh an expectation to match candidate output.

Required exact comparisons:

1. All 29 unchanged `3B` language entries, complete exact diagnostic lists and human/JSON-line bytes, including the whole-program later-function resolution precedence case. No source decomposition into independently compiled functions is equivalent
2. Six scalar bool/i32/unit lengths0/1, every empty leaf/Group slot; grouped store's exact IDs 0..9, roots [5,7], one absent target-wrapper HIR read, 11 AST/10 HIR, all retained origins and typed slots; literal1024 full child order and N; structural identities and cross-file actual callee links; complete child-only diagnostic wording/origins
3. Small new reference-mode case: both shared and exclusive writes type successfully, preserve reference mode and exact operand IDs. It carries no ownership/E0313 success claim. The same-signature callee fixture must name chosen DefId1, never decoy DefId2 despite equal signatures. Compare root entry and unused child rows as part of the whole project
4. Internal guard denial/renderings for every listed program entry and applicable function entry, including no-function inputs. All pre-output sentinels are zero. Check the original root EOF even when only the child contains a record. Reject omitted controls as missing coverage
5. Literal exact-N request sequence and failures, cumulative entries across module/function boundaries, independent E_hir inventory and E_ast cross-check; the real reserve error and synthetic checked overflow remain separate receipts. Work and layout measurements satisfy RESOURCE.md, not invented expected byte numbers
6. Existing array-free record/scalar compatibility and executable/parser/raw closed-gate tests retain their own original authorities. Report which were actually exercised; this package's source facts alone cannot certify them

Completeness comparisons are over actual full vectors/row counts. Where `positive-facts.json` states a selected subset rather than enumerating every old scalar row, require the observer's structural completeness and all-slot checks and compare the listed source predicates exactly. Generic completeness checks cannot substitute for explicit expected IDs/roots/types in the grouped and empty cases. Canonical type serialization is scalar bool/i32/unit, fixed_array(element,length), record(actual RecordId+declaration origin), or ParameterTy value/reference(kind,aggregate); reference modes are not ValueTy. Display spells unit as `()` and uses canonical decimal array length.

Mandatory comparator sensitivity mutates copies of an already complete observation only: swap RHS/index roots; insert a target HIR read; remove a Group slot; make empty-call/return/nested negative appear typed-success; conflate zero-length bool/i32/unit or record/array identity; change chosen to same-signature decoy; change a child file ID, declaration or binding origin; remove/reorder a diagnostic secondary; alter diagnostic bytes; duplicate/drop a row or ID; omit an end/phase marker; mark a partial error as success; truncate a literal child list; corrupt request N/cumulative count; reset work at the child module; and change a guard sentinel to nonzero. Every mutation must be rejected, with the triggering check recorded. No actual production mutant is authorized by these requests.

The observer does not consume this JSON, its expected diagnostics, any comparator callback, or a candidate-output-derived oracle. A test driver may supply fixture path/scope/downward limits and request fixed observation categories, then pass inert observations to the external comparator. Type-slot inventory and HIR postorder cannot certify the deferred rhs-snapshot effects, helper99 versus snapshot5, final store suppression, E0601/E0606 precedence, cleanup or loan release. No lowering/runtime/fuel/pilot qualification is requested.
